import Mathlib

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def longest_palindromic_substring_precond (s : Array UInt8) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  s.size ≤ 1000000
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
def palCheck (s : Array UInt8) (start len : Nat) : Nat → Bool
  | 0 => true
  | k + 1 =>
      decide (s.getD (start + k) 0 = s.getD (start + len - 1 - k) 0) && palCheck s start len k

def isPalSlice (s : Array UInt8) (start len : Nat) : Bool :=
  palCheck s start len len

def stepBest (s : Array UInt8) (acc p : Nat × Nat) : Nat × Nat :=
  if isPalSlice s p.1 p.2 = true ∧ acc.2 < p.2 then p else acc

def scanLen (s : Array UInt8) (st : Nat) : Nat → (Nat × Nat) → (Nat × Nat)
  | 0, acc => acc
  | b + 1, acc => stepBest s (scanLen s st b acc) (st, b)

def scanStart (s : Array UInt8) : Nat → (Nat × Nat) → (Nat × Nat)
  | 0, acc => acc
  | m + 1, acc => scanLen s m (s.size + 1 - m) (scanStart s m acc)
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definitions
def longest_palindromic_substring (s : Array UInt8)
    (_ : longest_palindromic_substring_precond s) :
    Nat × Nat :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  scanStart s (s.size + 1) (0, 0)
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Helper definitions
def is_valid_subrange (s : Array UInt8) (start len : Nat) : Prop :=
  start + len ≤ s.size

-- A sequence slice s[start, start+len) is a palindrome if for all i < len,
-- s[start + i] == s[start + len - 1 - i]
def is_palindrome_slice (s : Array UInt8) (start len : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ i, i < len → s.getD (start + i) 0 = s.getD (start + len - 1 - i) 0

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def longest_palindromic_substring_postcond
    (s : Array UInt8) (result : Nat × Nat)
    (_ : longest_palindromic_substring_precond s) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  let (start, len) := result
  is_valid_subrange s start len ∧
  is_palindrome_slice s start len ∧
  (∀ i l, is_valid_subrange s i l → is_palindrome_slice s i l → l ≤ len)
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
lemma palCheck_iff (s : Array UInt8) (start len : Nat) : ∀ b : Nat,
    palCheck s start len b = true ↔
      ∀ i, i < b → s.getD (start + i) 0 = s.getD (start + len - 1 - i) 0 := by
  intro b
  induction b with
  | zero =>
    constructor
    · intro _ i hi
      exact absurd hi (Nat.not_lt_zero i)
    · intro _
      rfl
  | succ k ih =>
    simp only [palCheck, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq, ih]
    constructor
    · intro h i hi
      by_cases hik : i = k
      · subst hik
        exact h.1
      · exact h.2 i (by omega)
    · intro h
      exact ⟨h k (by omega), fun i hi => h i (by omega)⟩

lemma isPalSlice_iff (s : Array UInt8) (start len : Nat) :
    isPalSlice s start len = true ↔ is_palindrome_slice s start len :=
  palCheck_iff s start len len

lemma stepBest_mono (s : Array UInt8) (acc p : Nat × Nat) :
    acc.2 ≤ (stepBest s acc p).2 := by
  unfold stepBest
  split
  · rename_i hc
    exact Nat.le_of_lt hc.2
  · exact Nat.le_refl _

lemma stepBest_ge (s : Array UInt8) (acc p : Nat × Nat)
    (h : isPalSlice s p.1 p.2 = true) : p.2 ≤ (stepBest s acc p).2 := by
  unfold stepBest
  split
  · exact Nat.le_refl _
  · rename_i hc
    have hnl : ¬ (acc.2 < p.2) := fun hlt => hc ⟨h, hlt⟩
    omega

lemma stepBest_inv (s : Array UInt8) (acc p : Nat × Nat)
    (hacc : acc.1 + acc.2 ≤ s.size ∧ isPalSlice s acc.1 acc.2 = true)
    (hp : p.1 + p.2 ≤ s.size) :
    (stepBest s acc p).1 + (stepBest s acc p).2 ≤ s.size ∧
      isPalSlice s (stepBest s acc p).1 (stepBest s acc p).2 = true := by
  unfold stepBest
  split
  · rename_i hc
    exact ⟨hp, hc.1⟩
  · exact hacc

lemma scanLen_mono (s : Array UInt8) (st : Nat) : ∀ (b : Nat) (acc : Nat × Nat),
    acc.2 ≤ (scanLen s st b acc).2 := by
  intro b
  induction b with
  | zero => intro acc; exact Nat.le_refl _
  | succ k ih =>
    intro acc
    simp only [scanLen]
    exact Nat.le_trans (ih acc) (stepBest_mono s _ _)

lemma scanLen_inv (s : Array UInt8) (st : Nat) : ∀ (b : Nat) (acc : Nat × Nat),
    st + b ≤ s.size + 1 →
    (acc.1 + acc.2 ≤ s.size ∧ isPalSlice s acc.1 acc.2 = true) →
    ((scanLen s st b acc).1 + (scanLen s st b acc).2 ≤ s.size ∧
      isPalSlice s (scanLen s st b acc).1 (scanLen s st b acc).2 = true) := by
  intro b
  induction b with
  | zero => intro acc _ h; exact h
  | succ k ih =>
    intro acc hb h
    simp only [scanLen]
    exact stepBest_inv s (scanLen s st k acc) (st, k) (ih acc (by omega) h)
      (show st + k ≤ s.size by omega)

lemma scanLen_ge (s : Array UInt8) (st : Nat) : ∀ (b : Nat) (acc : Nat × Nat) (l : Nat),
    l < b → isPalSlice s st l = true → l ≤ (scanLen s st b acc).2 := by
  intro b
  induction b with
  | zero =>
    intro acc l hl _
    exact absurd hl (Nat.not_lt_zero l)
  | succ k ih =>
    intro acc l hl hp
    simp only [scanLen]
    by_cases hlk : l = k
    · have h2 : isPalSlice s (st, k).1 (st, k).2 = true := by
        show isPalSlice s st k = true
        rw [← hlk]
        exact hp
      have h3 : k ≤ (stepBest s (scanLen s st k acc) (st, k)).2 :=
        stepBest_ge s (scanLen s st k acc) (st, k) h2
      omega
    · exact Nat.le_trans (ih acc l (by omega) hp) (stepBest_mono s _ _)

lemma scanStart_mono (s : Array UInt8) : ∀ (m : Nat) (acc : Nat × Nat),
    acc.2 ≤ (scanStart s m acc).2 := by
  intro m
  induction m with
  | zero => intro acc; exact Nat.le_refl _
  | succ k ih =>
    intro acc
    simp only [scanStart]
    exact Nat.le_trans (ih acc) (scanLen_mono s k _ _)

lemma scanStart_inv (s : Array UInt8) : ∀ (m : Nat) (acc : Nat × Nat),
    m ≤ s.size + 1 →
    (acc.1 + acc.2 ≤ s.size ∧ isPalSlice s acc.1 acc.2 = true) →
    ((scanStart s m acc).1 + (scanStart s m acc).2 ≤ s.size ∧
      isPalSlice s (scanStart s m acc).1 (scanStart s m acc).2 = true) := by
  intro m
  induction m with
  | zero => intro acc _ h; exact h
  | succ k ih =>
    intro acc hm h
    simp only [scanStart]
    exact scanLen_inv s k (s.size + 1 - k) (scanStart s k acc) (by omega)
      (ih acc (by omega) h)

lemma scanStart_ge (s : Array UInt8) : ∀ (m : Nat) (acc : Nat × Nat) (st l : Nat),
    st < m → st + l ≤ s.size → isPalSlice s st l = true →
    l ≤ (scanStart s m acc).2 := by
  intro m
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    intro acc st l hst _ _
    exact absurd hst (Nat.not_lt_zero st)
  | succ k ih =>
    intro acc st l hst hsl hp
    simp only [scanStart]
    by_cases hsk : st = k
    · have hb : l < s.size + 1 - k := by omega
      exact scanLen_ge s k (s.size + 1 - k) (scanStart s k acc) l hb
        (by rw [← hsk]; exact hp)
    · exact Nat.le_trans (ih acc st l (by omega) hsl hp) (scanLen_mono s k _ _)
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem longest_palindromic_substring_postcond_satisfied
    (s : Array UInt8) (h_precond : longest_palindromic_substring_precond s) :
    longest_palindromic_substring_postcond
      s (longest_palindromic_substring s h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  have hbase : (0, 0).1 + (0, 0).2 ≤ s.size ∧ isPalSlice s (0, 0).1 (0, 0).2 = true := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · show 0 + 0 ≤ s.size
      omega
    · show isPalSlice s 0 0 = true
      rfl
  have hinv := scanStart_inv s (s.size + 1) (0, 0) (Nat.le_refl _) hbase
  have h1 : is_valid_subrange s (longest_palindromic_substring s h_precond).1
      (longest_palindromic_substring s h_precond).2 := hinv.1
  have h2 : is_palindrome_slice s (longest_palindromic_substring s h_precond).1
      (longest_palindromic_substring s h_precond).2 :=
    (isPalSlice_iff s _ _).mp hinv.2
  have h3 : ∀ i l, is_valid_subrange s i l → is_palindrome_slice s i l →
      l ≤ (longest_palindromic_substring s h_precond).2 := by
    intro i l hval hpal
    have hv : i + l ≤ s.size := hval
    exact scanStart_ge s (s.size + 1) (0, 0) i l (by omega) hv
      ((isPalSlice_iff s i l).mpr hpal)
  exact ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
  -- !benchmark @end proof

The postcondition demands three things about the returned `(start, len)`:
1. `start + len ≤ s.size`,
2. the slice is a palindrome,
3. **maximality**: every valid palindromic slice has length `≤ len`.

Manacher's algorithm is extremely hard to verify formally (mirror-symmetry reasoning, amortized boundary updates). Since the specification only constrains the *result*, I implement a fully verifiable exhaustive search that computes exactly the same answer specification: scan all pairs `(start, len)` with `start + len ≤ s.size`, keep the palindromic one of maximal length. `(0,0)` is always a valid palindromic candidate, so the accumulator is always well-formed.

To avoid depending on fragile list-lemma names, everything is written with **self-contained structural recursion over `Nat`**:

* `palCheck s start len b` — checks the symmetry condition for all `i < b`; `isPalSlice := palCheck s st l l`.
* `stepBest s acc p` — replaces `acc` by `p` if `p` is palindromic and strictly longer.
* `scanLen s st b acc` — folds `stepBest` over lengths `0 … b-1`.
* `scanStart s m acc` — folds `scanLen` over starts `0 … m-1`, each with lengths up to `s.size + 1 - st`.

* `*_mono`: the accumulated length never decreases (needed to propagate lower bounds forward),
* `*_inv`: the accumulator always is a valid palindromic subrange (invariant),
* `*_ge`: every enumerated palindromic candidate's length bounds the final result (maximality),
* `isPalSlice_iff`: the boolean check is equivalent to the `Prop`-level `is_palindrome_slice`.
